book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn LUK

content: Koasoanepen Kamalahn Sises
Ahnsoun Sarawien Pilawa Sohte Doal Ihs, me adaneki Pahsohpa kerendohr.
A samworo lapalap ako oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko raparapahki dahme re kak wia pwe re en kemehla Sises; pwe re masak kowahlap aramas akan.
Sudas Inoukihda en Pangala Sises
Sehdan eri pedolong nan kapehd en Sudas, me adaneki Iskariot, emen me ehk riemeno.
Sudas eri kohla oh kalelapak rehn samworo lapalap oh kaunen Tehnpas Sarawio ko duwen eh pahn pangalahng irail Sises.
Irail eri perenkihda kowahlap oh pwungkipene re en pwainkihong mwohni.
Sudas pil perenkihda oh tapihada awiawih ahnsou mwahu me e kak pangohng irail Sises ni aramas akan ar sohte pahn ese.
Sises Onopada Iang Konot en Pahsohpa
Sarawien Pilawa Sohte Doal Ihs ahpw leledo, ahnsou me sihmpwul en kamadipw en Pahsohpa kin kamala.
Sises eri ketin poaronehla Piter oh Sohn, mahsanihong ira, “Kumwa kohwei oh kaunopadahng kitail atail tehpel en Pahsohpa.”
Ira eri patohwan idek, “Ia wasa komw kupwurki se en patohwan onopada ie?”
A e ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Kumwa kilang, ni amwa pahn pedolong nan kahnimwo, kumwa pahn tuhwong ohl emen me weuwa pekid en pihl ehu. Kumwa idawehn, e lao pedolong nan ihmw ehu.
Kumwa ahpw pahn ndahng kaunen ihmwo, ‘Sounpadahko poaroneikitodohng rehmwi, mahsanih: Ia pere me ngehi oh nei tohnpadahk kan pahn tungoale ie kamadipw en Pahsohpa?’
E ahpw pahn kasalehiong kumwa pere kalaimwun ehu powe me koasoansoandier, oh ih wasao me kumwa pahn kaunopada ie soahng koaros.”
Ira ahpw patopatohla oh diarada soahng koaros duwen Sises eh mahsanihong ira, oh ira ahpw kaunopada kamadipw en Pahsohpa.
Sapwellimen Kaun-o Kamadipw en Kamwurimwur
Ni ahnsoun konoto eh leledo, Sises oh sapwellime wahnpoaron ko ketidiong nan mwoalarail nin tehpelo.
Ih eri mahsanihong irail, “I ngoangkihlahte mehlel iang kumwail wia kamadipw en Pahsohpa wet mwohn ei pahn lokolok.
Kumwail en ese pwe I solahr pahn pwurehng iang tungoale Pahsohpa wet, e lao pahn ale kawehwehpe unsek nan Wehin Koht.”
Sises eri ketikihda dahl ehu, kapingkalahngan ong Koht, mahsanih, “Kumwail ale dahl wet oh iang nimasang.
Kumwail en ese pwe I solahr pahn pwurehng nim wain wet sang met kohla, lao lel ahnsou me Wehin Koht pahn pweida.”

Mwuhr, e ahpw ketikihda pilawa ieu, kapingkalahngan ong Koht, ketin pilitikihpeseng pilawao oh ketikihong irail, mahsanih, “Iei werei met me pengpengkinkumwaillahr. Kumwail wia met ong ni katamanpei.”
Pil duwehte, mwurin konoto, e ketikihong irail dahl ehu, mahsanih, “Dahl wet iei delen sapwellimen Koht inou kapw me wiawihkidahr ntai, me kepwilipwildier pwehki kumwail.
“Ahpw iet! Me pengiehlao iang ie mihmi met nin tehpel wet!
Mehlel pwe Nein-Aramas pahn mehla duwen Koht eh ketin kileledier; ahpw meid suwediong aramaso me pahn pangala!”
Irail eri tapihada peidekpene nanpwungarail, ihs rehrail me pahn kak wia soahng wet.
Akamaipen ihs me Lapalap rehn Tohnpadahk ko
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw akamaikihda ihs me pahn lapalap rehrail.
Sises ketin mahsanihong irail, “Nanmwarki kan en sampah kin sapwellimanki manaman en kaunda wasa pohn sapwellimarail aramas akan, oh aramas akan kin kamwarehki arail kaun akan ‘Mwohnsapw Kalahngan.’
Ahpw e sohte pahn duwehte rehmwail; pwe me keieu lapalap rehmwail pahn duwehte me keieu tikitik, oh me kin kaun pahn duwehte lidu.
Pwe ihs me lapalap rehn me kin mwohndiong nin tehpel pwe en konot, de me kin papah? Kaidehkin me kin mwohndiong nin tehpel? Ahpw iet, ngehi I kin mihmi rehmwail duwehte papah men.
“Kumwail kin mihmihte rehi ahnsou koaros nan ei apwal akan;
oh nin duwen Semei eh ketikihongieier manaman en kaunda wasa, I pil pahn kihong kumwail soangen manamanohte.
Kumwail pahn iang ie konot de sak ni ei tehpel nan ei Wehi, oh kumwail pahn iang mwohd nan mwoalomwail mwoalen kopwung pwe en wia kapwungpen kadaudok eisek riaun Israel.”
Sises Kohpada en Piter eh pahn Kahmahmki
“Saimon, Saimon! Kilang pwe Sehdan aleier mweimwei pwe en song kumwail koaros duwehte soumwet men eh kin koakoahsang kilin wahn pilawa.
Ahpw I kapakapkin uhk, Saimon, pwe omw pwoson en dehr luwetala. Oh ni omw pahn sapahldohng rehi, ke pahn kakehlahda pwoson en riomw kan.”
Piter sapeng, patohwan, “Maing ei Kaun, I onopadahr I en iangkomwihla nan imweteng oh iang komwi pwoula.”
A Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Piter, ke en ese pwe rahnwet, mwohn keieun malek eh pahn kakorot, ke pahn kahmahmkin ie pahn silipak me ke sehse ie.”
Edin Mwohni, Koaruk en Seiloak, oh Kedlahs
Sises ahpw keinemwe rehn sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Ni ei kadarkumwailewei sohte wa edin mwohni, koaruk en seiloak, de suht, mie mehkot me kumwail apwalkihda?” Re patohwanohng, “Sohte, Maing.”
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Eri met, ma mie me nah edin mwohni oh koaruk en seiloak mie, a en wahda; a me sohte nah kedlahs, a en netikihla eh likou puhp oh pwainkihda apwoat kedlahsen.
Pwe kumwail en ese pwe mahsen en Pwuhk Sarawi wet uhdahn pahn pweida rehi, me mahsanih, ‘E ahpw iang wadawad ong aramas dipan akan.’ Pwe me ntingdier duwen ngehi, e kin pweida.”
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing at Kaun, iet kedlahs riapwoat!” A Sises mahsanih, “E itarehr!”
Sises Kasakas nin Nahnahn Olip
Sises eri ketieisang nan kahnimwo, ketilahng ni Nahnahn Olip, duwen me e kin ketin epwehnki wia; sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw iangala.
Ni eh ketin lel wasao, e ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail kapakap pwe kumwail dehr lohdiong nan songosong.”
Ih eri ketin tohrohrala sang irail, ni uwen dohen aramas eh kin koaski takai ehu; e ahpw ketin kelehpwikihdi oh loulou,
mahsanih, “Ipa, ma komw ketin kupwurki, a komw ketikihweisang ie delen lokolok wet. Ahpw soh, kaidehkin nsenei, pwe kupwuromwihte en pweida.”
[Tohnleng men sang nanleng ahpw pwarodohng oh karosonda.
Oh ni eh pwunodadahr kowahlap, e ahpw ketin ngiangiong sapwellime kasakas; pwudowe lao kerediong nanpwel likamwete dingiding en ntahn aramas.]
E ahpw ketida sang sapwellime loulou oh ketidiong rehn sapwellime tohnpadahk ko oh diarihrada ar memeirkelik, pwehki eh sohla angihrki ar nsensuwed.
Ih eri mahsanihong irail, “Dahme kumwail memeirki? Kumwail pwourda oh kapakap pwe kumwail dehr lohdiong nan songosong.”
Sises ketin Selidi
Nindokon eh mahmahsen, pokon ehu ahpw lel wasao; Sudas, emen me ehk riemeno, me kahre irail. Ih eri keilahngete mpen Sises, metik ih.
A Sises mahsanih, “Sudas, metik ehu me ke pangkilahr Nein-Aramas?”
Ni tohnpadahk ko me iang Sises ar kilangada dahme pahn wiawio, re ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Maing at Kaun, se en doadoahngki nait kedlahs kat?”
Emen irail ahpw pelehte en Samworo Lapalap eh ladu men, pelehsang salenge palimaun.
Sises ahpw mahsanih, “Eriher!” Ih eri ketin doahkehte salengen ohlo, kamwawihala.

Sises eri mahsanihong samworo lapalap ako oh soumas en Tehnpas Sarawio, oh pil kaunen mehn Suhs ako me iang patohdohng reh, “Kumwail kohieidohng rapahkin ie wisik kedlahs oh mehn pei, likamwete kumwail kodohng rapahki loallap suwed men?
I kin mihmihte rehmwail rahn koaros nan Tehnpas Sarawio, kumwail ahpw sohte mwahn song en salihiehdi. A met, iei amwail ahnsou, oh ahnsoun manaman en rotorot.”
Piter Kahmahmki Sises
Irail eri salihedi Sises oh kahrelahng ni imwen Samworo Lapalap; a Piter ideidawehnte ahpw mwur dohsang ekis.
Nanwerengen kelen Samworo Lapalapo, kisiniei kis ahpw souda. Piter eri iang mwohndi rehn me mwomwohd kapilpene kisinieio.
Ni emen lidu ko eh kilangda eh iang mwomwohd limwahn kisinieio, e ahpw kangkakil oh nda, “Lahp menet pil iengen ohlo.”
Piter eri kahmahmkihda, ndalahng, “Lih, I sehse ohl menet!”
Mwurin ahnsou kis, ohl emen pil kilangada Piter, e ahpw pil ndalahng, “Kowe pil emen ienge ko!” A Piter sapeng, nda, “Nahn, kaidehkin iengei!”
Kedekedeo, mwurin awa ieu, pil emen akahkpwungkihte, nda, “Mehlelete pwe lahp menet uhdahn iengen ohlo, pwe ih mehn Kalili men!”
Piter sapeng, nda, “Maing, I sohte wehwehki dahme ke ndindahn!” A ni ahnsowohte, nindokon eh lokolokaia, malek pa kakorot.

Kaun-o eri ketin sohpeidohng Piter oh ketin kamoalehdi. Piter ahpw tamankihda mahsen en Kaun-o, me mahsanih, “Rahnwet, mwohn keieun malek eh pahn kakorot, ke pahn kahmahmki pahn silipak me ke sehse ie.”
Piter eri kohkohlahsang, kohieila liki oh sengiseng kowahlap.
Sises Wiahla mehn Kepit oh Wowoki
Aramas ako me sinsile Sises ahpw kin kapikapitih oh kin wokih.
Re kin perehla silangi oh kin idek, “Ihs me wokih komwio? Komw kasawihada mahs!”
Re ahpw pil kin lahlahwe oh wiahiong kapweikeng tohto.
Sises Ket Mwohn Mwoalen Kopwung Lapalap
Ni eh rahnpeseng, kaunen mehn Suhs ako, samworo lapalap oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko ahpw pokonpene, oh Sises ahpw pakahrdohng mwohn Tohn Mwoalen Kopwung Lapalapo.
Irail eri idek, patohwan, “Komw mahsanidohng kiht mahs, ma komwi iei Mesaia.” A e ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ma I ndaiong kumwail, kumwail sohte pahn kamehlele ie.
A ma I idek rehmwail mehkot, kumwail sohte pahn sapeng ie.
Ahpw kumwail en ese pwe sang met kohla Nein-Aramas pahn ket nan mwoale ni palimaun en Koht, Wasa Lapalahpie.”
Irail koaros eri patohwan idek, “Eri, Sapwellimen Kohto komwi?” A e ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Pein kumwail ndinda pwe iei ngehi ih.”
Irail ahpw nda, “Eri, kitail sohte anahne sounkadehde, pwe pein kitail rongasangehr nan pein sapwellime mahsen kan!”
